title: Microbiota as a biomarker of tuberculosis treatment response: association with clinical history, inflammation and outcome.
snippet: Tuberculosis requires prolonged multidrug therapy. Whether this disrupts the microbiota in ways reflecting previous treatment exposure and outcome is unknown.
